channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran, Kuwait, Bahrain hit: Is the war in the Gulf escalating again?
item.description: Secretary of State Rubio tells US lawmakers the war on Iran is over, amid recent attacks on Iran and Gulf countries.

item.title: Hezbollah video shows attack on Israeli troops at Lebanon’s Beaufort Castle
item.description: Hezbollah has released drone video showing attacks targeting Israeli forces occupying Beaufort Castle

item.title: US ‘disables’ ship allegedly bound for Iranian port
item.description: US Central Command released video of it targeting a tanker that it says was en route to Iran’s Kharg Island in the Gulf.

item.title: Iranian drone attack kills one in Kuwait after US strikes Qeshm Island
item.description: Gulf country's airport is hit as clashes go on with diplomacy between Washington and Tehran showing little progress.

item.title: What’s happening on day 96 of Iran war as US, Iran engage in new attacks
item.description: Rubio says the US will lift sanctions on Iran only if it gives up enriched uranium, rejecting a Hormuz-linked deal.

item.title: US and Iran launch new strikes, as Kuwait says airport hit by Iranian drones
item.description: Kuwait says one person is dead after drones hit civilian buildings including its international airport.

item.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon but partial truce with Hezbollah appears to hold
item.description: Israel continues its campaign in the south, though has not struck Beirut after a deal announced by the US.

item.title: Eight killed after drone hits bus in Russia-controlled part of Ukraine
item.description: The bus was travelling between Moscow and Simferopol, in Russian-controlled Crimea, an official says.

item.title: Foreign nationals among at least 21 killed in Delhi fire
item.description: Many victims were South Asians who had travelled to India for treatment or to accompany relatives.

item.title: British couple lose Iran jail sentence appeal, family says
item.description: Lindsay and Craig Foreman were arrested in January 2025 during a global motorbike journey.
